title: Michigan Dept. of State Police v. Sitz (1990)
citation: Michigan Dep't of State Police v. Sitz, 496 U.S. 444 (1990)
key_points: Holding: Properly run sobriety checkpoints, stopping all vehicles under a neutral plan for a brief period, are constitutional.
officer_notes: Scenario: Your agency sets up a DWI checkpoint with supervisory approval, advance notice and stops every car.
Takeaway: Follow your agency's checkpoint plan exactly; discretion by individual officers undermines it.
